author: SickProdigy
description: An experimental persistent two-player Yu-Gi-Oh duel prototype with private hands, fixed beginner decks, and a deliberately bounded legacy-style rules subset.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, active duel state, private hands and decks, public actions, and channel/message identifiers. User deletion removes duels involving that user.
install_msg: Start with [p]yugioh challenge @member. This prototype supports only its documented fixed decks and explicit rules subset.
name: YuGiOh
